cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import ipaddress, json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fib
rng=random.Random(9)
def rows_target(target, routes=None):
    routes = routes or {(0,0):0}
    rows=[["::/0",0]]+[[str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(s))+"/%d"%l,h] for (s,l),h in routes.items() if (s,l)!=(0,0)]
    hop=max(list(routes.values()),default=0)+1
    guard=0
    while len(fib.runs_of(routes)[0])<target and guard<5000:
        guard+=1
        length=rng.choice([128,120,96,64,48])
        v=rng.getrandbits(128); size=1<<(128-length); v=(v//size)*size
        if (v,length) in routes: continue
        trial=dict(routes); trial[(v,length)]=hop
        if len(fib.runs_of(trial)[0])<=target:
            routes=trial; rows.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))+"/%d"%length,hop]); hop+=1
    return rows, routes
# 8 versions each with exactly 16 runs: build routes once, then per transaction change
# hops of routes already present so the run count stays 16
rows, routes = rows_target(16)
tx=[]
base=dict(routes)
for k in range(7):
    ch=[]
    for (s,l),h in list(base.items()):
        if (s,l)==(0,0): continue
        if rng.random()<0.15:
            ch.append(["set", str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(s))+"/%d"%l, h+1])
            base[(s,l)]=h+1
    if not ch: ch=[["set", rows[1][0], rng.randint(0,3)]]
    tx.append([ch])   # one change per transaction to keep versions stable in size
    base=dict(routes)
# rebuild: apply transactions one change each to preserve run counts
tx=[]
cur=dict(routes)
for k in range(7):
    key=rng.choice([kk for kk in cur if kk!=(0,0)])
    cur[key]=rng.randint(0,50)
    tx.append([["set", "%s/%d"%(ipaddress.IPv6Address(key[0]), key[1]), cur[key]]])
bursts=[]
for v in range(8):
    for _ in range(4):
        bursts.append({"version":v,"repeat":rng.randint(1,5000),
                       "addresses":[str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(rng.getrandbits(128))) for _ in range(8)]})
case={"initial":rows,"transactions":tx,"bursts":bursts,"cache_pages":12,
      "costs":{"hit":1,"miss":16,"decode":[0,1,2]}}
payload=json.dumps({"cases":[case]}).encode()
from protocol import parse_request
norm=parse_request(payload)
vs=[fib.publish(c["initial"],c["transactions"]) for c in norm]
print("R per version",[len(s) for s,_ in vs[0]], "total", sum(len(s) for s,_ in vs[0]))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","/workspace/submission/main.py"],input=payload,capture_output=True)
print("compile %.2fs rc=%d"%(time.time()-t,p.returncode), p.stderr.decode()[-200:])
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("objective",out["cases"][0]["objective"])
import light
light.check(json.loads(payload),out,samples=15)
print("LIGHT OK")
PY
